title: Chicago Officer Discovers He's Outgunned in This Neighborhood
description:
Thankfully, there were no serious injuries as a result of the encounter.

transcript.text: On May 31st, 2023, at approximately 7.15 p.m., an off-duty Chicago PD officer named Kwan Spencer, pulled up to a dumpster blocking an alleyway on West May Pole while driving his personal vehicle. The investigation indicates that preliminary information received on the scene, indicated that after moving the dumpster, Officer Spencer was fired upon, prompting him to run back to his vehicle and return fire. However, third-party footage shows a different story entirely. A separate angle, which shows the officer in the top right corner, appears to show the officer discharging his firearm prior to being shot at. As soon as the officer fires the initial shot, multiple individuals scurry to cover, and they have no way to know he is an off-duty police officer. Two individuals begin to return fire in the direction of the officer. A total of 20 shots are fired, the officer retreats to his vehicle, but then drives in the direction of those who shot at him. This prompts a subsequent shootout in a press release published a month later. Copa stated that, after further review of third-party video, it is unclear and has not yet been determined that the officer was fired upon first.
